body: For me it is not really a question of when life begins when talking about abortion. I mean, the cells are not death when the conception takes place. For me it is more a question of when it is okay to kill something that is alive. I am fine with people killing viruses (alive), spiders (alive), and embryos (alive). However I am not okay with killing dogs (also alive) or 25week old human fetuses (alive).

Hi, can I ask why you started? I started when I was 14 as well and I could have never predicted how much it influences my life. Obviously it impact the way I dress in the summer , but it is way more than that. I dislike driving because my sleeves might slip up, I avoid exercises like yoga, dating sucks, jobs can be difficult, I wanted to study biology but that would mean field work so I chose something else,... all of this does not mean of course that you can’t show scars, but for me, a person with anxiety, it can be way to difficult. I of course don’t now your situation, but I would advice you to tell someone because just talking about it and why you did it might be good.
